title: Accu-Chek Combo Page not showing Values with 3.3.0.0
body:
After Update to Version 3.3.0.0 on the Combo Page there are missing some Values:
Driver Status, Last Connection to Pump, Battery, Reservoir.
With Version 3.2.* those Values were shown.

![Screenshot_20250101-153634~3](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7595a757-83f6-49d7-b4e8-1386b82cc314)

On the main page i can see the content in ml of the reservoir. That means the data is  there and i have also checked, the values are correct. So this is just a display Issue.

comments.body:
I don't have the logs becase i have set them to Log nothing a long time ago. And also: Now i can See this Data, i don't know why. I have even tried to kill aaps to reproduce it, but directly after start the status is shown, not like in the screenshot i have added.
I don't know how to proceed, I will just close this because i can not reproduce it.
`app.aaps.core.ui.R.attr.defaultTextColor` is used on many places without problem

Now i do get it.
To reproduce: Set pixel phone to automatic mode for design.
Set aaps to dark background. In this case the System default Color for text is used. This is black in the case of this screenshot, because system settings are used.
@swissalpine : As a workaround i have set aaps to use the system design settings. At the moment everything works. Using the dark design is broken on Pixel with the automatic change.

> `app.aaps.core.ui.R.attr.defaultTextColor` is used on many places without problem

Yes, I know, but unfortunately not in the combo tab.

> As a workaround i have set aaps to use the system design settings. At the moment everything works. Using the dark design is broken on Pixel with the automatic change.

Unfortunately, this workaround does not work for me because I use my Samsung Galaxy Flip 4 in light mode. Unfortunately, the light mode is much worse than the dark mode in AAPS (contrasts, colors), so I can't go to system settings here.
But I can personally live with my commenting out - but it will affect others who don't know how to help themselves.
hmmm it didn't work even on @jbr7rr 's initial commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/424128d65c902d1da75a1d9ea4ae21bbf1d3885b

Yes, it only changed the problem, instead of white color on white background (light mode) now black on black (dark mode).

I suspect that my workaround might be a solution if you only define the deviations urgent and warn, and otherwise leave the text color as it is.
This would only require reformulating the two when queries.
If that is a solution for you @MilosKozak, I can prepare a fix
